scheme_name: Shravan Kumar Shramik Parivar Tirth Yatra Yojana
other_conditions: The worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Factories Act, 1948
The worker's combined basic salary and dearness allowance must not exceed ₹15,000 per month
The worker must have completed at least six months of continuous service in the establishment and must be in service at the time of application
If both the worker and his wife are employed as workers in factories/establishments, only one of them is eligible for the benefit

The family may include the worker, wife, up to two unmarried children, the worker's parents, and mother‑in‑law and father‑in‑law in case of a female worker, with the total number of members not exceeding six
Only two children of the worker’s family and the dependent mother/father can be included
The worker can avail the benefit only once during his entire service period
If applications exceed the budget for the financial year, workers with the maximum age will be selected on a priority basis
The last date for receiving applications in each financial year is 30 September
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum assistance of up to ₹12,000 for travel expenses.
documents_required: Scanned copy of the verified application form and supporting documents
